GULF CREST BUILDERS LLC — PURCHASE ORDER (DRAFT, rev. A)
PO No.: GCB/PRC/MQ-TB/PO-0412  ·  Date: 06/10/2026
Supplier: Raseen Building Materials Trading LLC, Al Quoz Industrial 3, Dubai
Project: Marina Quarter Tower B (plot MN-08-204-0019)
Ref.: your quotation Q-2026-0918 dated 18/09/2026 and meeting 24/09/2026

1. RB-B500-16 rebar B500B 16 mm — 520 t @ AED 2,690/t
2. RB-B500-20 rebar B500B 20 mm — 310 t @ AED 2,680/t
3. RB-B500-25 rebar B500B 25 mm — 180 t @ AED 2,710/t
4. RB-B500-12 rebar B500B 12 mm — 95 t @ AED 2,735/t
5. CEM-SRC-50 sulphate-resisting cement — 14,500 bags @ AED 18.20
6. WPF-BIT-4 bitumen membrane 4 mm — 760 rolls @ AED 92.50

Prices as agreed with Mr. Ahmed Soliman (Raseen) in our meeting of 24 September 2026, exclusive of VAT.
Prices fixed and firm for the full project duration until 30 June 2027; no escalation.
Payment: 90 days from date of delivery.
Retention: 5% on each invoice, released at Tower B practical completion.
Delivery: to site 07:00–18:00, seven days a week incl. Sundays, against 24-hour call-off by site logistics.
This draft is issued for supplier confirmation and is not binding until signed by both parties.
